judged_text: The MeetLocationType guard destructures `evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` and then unconditionally reads `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration`, so a null or empty destinationCalendar throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'integration')`. Any CalendarEvent built with `destinationCalendar: []` or null (which this very diff introduces in packages/features/ee/payments/api/webhook.ts, paypal-webhook.ts, handleCancelBooking.ts and confirm.handler.ts) crashes the location-resolution step of EventManager whenever Google Meet location needs the fallback check; previously the `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration` optional chain made this path safe. Payment-success and reschedule flows that pass empty arrays now 500 instead of falling back to Cal Video.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the new Meet fallback logic does `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then unconditionally reads `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` (no optional chaining/guard). If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, `undefined`, or an empty array, `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is `undefined` and this will throw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'integration')`. The diff also introduces multiple call sites that now construct `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` as `[]` (e.g. `apps/web/pages/api/cron/bookingReminder.ts`, `packages/features/ee/payments/api/webhook.ts`, `packages/features/ee/payments/api/paypal-webhook.ts`, `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts`, `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts`), making this crash path realistically reachable.
